ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement") is entered into as of December 17, 2015, between Antonio Cruz and Kazimiera Cruz, both having an address at 21-11 45th Avenue, Long Island City, NY 11101, (hereinafter collectively called as "Owner"), and Impex Builders LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 1517 Voorhies Avenue, Suite 4R, Brooklyn, NY 11235, (hereinafter called as"Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owner is the owner in fee of.certain land, with the building and improvements thereon, located in the County of Queens, theCity and State of New York, known as Lot 6 in Block 78 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 21-11 45th Avenue, Long Island City, NY 11101, and more particularly described on Exhibit "A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land, building and improvements being hereinaftercalled the"OwnerParcel"); WHEREAS,Developer is the owner in fee that certain land with the building and improvements thereon located in the County of Queens, the City and State of New York, known as Lot 52 in Block 78 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork, and as and by the street address 21-10 44th Drive, Long Island City, NY 11101, and more particularly described on Exhibit "B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land, buildings and improvements being hereinafter called the "Developer Parcel"); and WHEREAS,Developer intends to construct a new miultiple dwelling building upon all or a portion of the Developer Parcel (said new building, with any further additions, alterations and : replacements thereof being hereinafter called the “New Building"; the Owner Parcel and the Developer Parcel are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the “Parcels"” and each individually as a "Parcel"); and WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the New Building will contain more floor area (hereinafter called as the “Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961, as amended (hereinafter called as the “Zoning Resolution") than is now available for use under the “floor area ratio” limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution related to the Developer Parcel as an independent zoning lot, with the combining the Developer Parcel and Owner Parcel into a single zoning lot solely for the purpose of determining compliance by the New Building with such limitation; WHEREAS, there exist Transferred Development Rights (hereinafter defined), which are appurtenant to the Owner Parcel, which are in excess ofjthe Development Rights utilized by the building andimprovementslocated thereon and the same are availablefor transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution. As used in this Agreement, the term "Transferred Development Rights" shall mean the total square footage of excess Development Rights not in use by Owner existing in connection with Owner Parcel, which is approximately 1,096.00 square feet.
